svg.title: Ingesting directly into Bronze Delta
svg.desc: The job picks what to load from its run type, authenticates for each call, requests the feed, retrieves the signed-URL files in manageable batches and writes them to Bronze with ingestion metadata. Retries are safe because a repeated write of the same batch is ignored, and a delivery is marked Bronze complete only after all its files are written.
svg.text: source records plus ingestion metadata, written safely and in batches
source fields kept as delivered, plus metadata
Proposed design. Names such as load_mode and the underscore-prefixed metadata columns are ours, not Walmart's. Example values are made up.
Authentication and delivery details are from my notes, not checked against Walmart's API reference.

g.text: The same code runs in three modes. Walmart requires history before incrementals, and recovery rechecks a range without duplicating successful loads.
signed URLs: downloads must start within 10 minutes
Each API call uses a fresh signature. Walmart returns one or more signed download URLs, not rows already in a table.
Large deliveries are processed in manageable batches, not assumed to fit in memory. Bronze keeps Walmart's fields and adds traceability metadata.
Bronze complete: all expected files written
A repeated write of the same batch is ignored through a stable identity and Delta's transaction identifiers. A delivery is Bronze complete only when all its expected files are written.
